140760564821.regression: Both tests are Known recurring failures. Neither passed in any of the 15 comparable runs below, all on images built from radixark/miles `main`.

hypotheses.text: No recent change is suspected. The gfx942 configuration of `dpsk_v4_fp8_partial_kernel` (`num_stages=1` at `tilelang_fp8_attention.py:973`) cannot be compiled by this TileLang build: `InjectSoftwarePipeline` refuses to reorder two dependent statements that land in the same pipeline stage. gfx950 uses `num_stages=0` (no software pipelining) and does not take this path.
A TileLang upgrade in the image (between Nov 1 and Nov 13) made a previously compilable `num_stages=1` kernel fail.

140760909685.cluster: DeepSeek-V4.1 indexer replay test: torch top-k indices differ between fallthrough and record

hypotheses.text: [radixark/miles#4740](https://github.com/radixark/miles/pull/4740) ([`a6f0c683e6`](https://github.com/radixark/miles/commit/a6f0c683e694452ff32a710b22fc005e427083b4)) added this test. The test assumes that two identical `torch.topk` calls over all-tied scores pick the same set of indices. ROCm's `torch.topk` does not guarantee that, so the torch variant is a test/platform mismatch rather than a production regression.

A timing dependency in the test: whether the pages are resident after `load_from` depends on host writeback timing. This is plausible because `POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED` cannot drop pages that are dirty or still under writeback, and the test dirties every bucket with `os.pwrite` just before `load_from`.
